*The "Blue Sea", a huge body of water spanning across the entire Blue Planet. Nearly everything in the world can be found on the Sea. But the sea is a vast, dangerous, and unpredictable realm, characterized by the Grand Line, Calm Belts, and the four major seas (East Blue, South Blue, West Blue, and North Blue), all separated by the Red Line.*

*The Red Line is a large, vertical landmass that’s tall as the sky and encircles the entire planet, acting as a barrier and dividing the world into two halves. Whereas the Calm Belts are two areas located north and south of the Grand Line, characterized by a lack of wind and ocean currents, and are also the nesting grounds for Sea Kings, making them dangerous to navigate. The Red Line and Calm Belt act as the divider between the four major seas, and trying to get from one major sea to the other is no easy task. Especially if one try’s going through the Grand Line.*

![M](https://files.catbox.moe/vxmhid.jpeg)

*Today was an exceptional day. The weather was calm, the salty water was still, the clouds pack gently together to provide shade, and the sun hovered over the sky just at the right position. It was even the best day for a News Coo gull to deliver newspapers and wanted posters to wandering ships. To whoever was sailing today would be spared from the harsh elements of the sea, just for today.*

*"Paradise" is the name of the first half of the Grand Line, an ocean route which wraps around the entire world, south of the North and East Blues and north of the South and West Blues. The Grand Line is separated from the Blues on both the north and south ends by the Calm Belt, where it is the nesting grounds for the world's largest Sea Kings, making passage into the Grand Line a bit difficult. The only way to access the Grand Line is via by a special ship with its hull being made of sea stone that wouldn’t alert the sea king creatures as one goes through the Calm Belt, or Reverse Mountain.*

*Reverse Mountain is an extremely tall mountain at one of the points where the four Blues meet and is one of the two known entrances to the Grand Line. Reverse Mountain is unique because rivers from the Blues (North Blue, East Blue, South Blue and West Blue) flow up the mountain, meet at the top, and then flow down into the Grand Line.*

*Even when one makes it to Paradise, it’s considered dangerous since the first half of the Grand Line possesses highly volatile and unpredictable weather conditions. Even navigating is difficult since compasses don’t work, so people who sail the seas in the Grand Line have to use a special compass called a Log Pose. Every island in Paradise presents its own unique challenges with its unique weather, and the level of difficulty seems to increase the farther one travels.*

![M](https://files.catbox.moe/dnbyz2.jpeg)

*But for why the first half of the Grand Line is called "Paradise", despite being difficult to navigate through its water is due to it being a nickname given by pirates fleeing from the New World, the second half of the Grand Line. The pirates who flee from the New World have seen and experience things that no one could likely survive from, and the New World was a place that only the strong could survive…*

*Besides the New World, today was a good day as the unpredictable weather seemed to calm down for now. It was a partial cloudy day, with a nice breeze and a nice amount of sunlight shining through the clouds.*

*The "New World" is the second half of the Grand Line, an ocean route which wraps around the entire world, south of the North and East Blues and north of the South and West Blues. The Grand Line is separated from the Blues on both the north and south ends by the Calm Belt, where it is the nesting grounds for the world's largest Sea Kings, making passage into the Grand Line a bit difficult. The only way to get to the New World is via by a special ship with its hull being made of sea stone that wouldn’t alert the sea king creatures as one goes through the Calm Belt, asking permission from the World Government to travel across the Red Line, or going 10,000 meters underwater, underneath the Red Line.*

*The Red Line is a vast ring-like continent which wraps around the entire world, east of the North and West Blues and west of the South and East Blues. It is the tallest and largest continent in the world. As its name implies, the Red Line is made of reddish mineral. The Holy Land Mary Geoise, the capital of the World Government, is located on top of the Red Line.*

*When one travels to the New World, it gets more worst. The first half of the Grand Line is referred to as "Paradise" when comparing it to the second half. One can lose everything one cherishes in the New World. The four strongest pirates in the world, the Four Emperors, reside in the New World with large amount of territories that the Marines wouldn’t dare enter.*

*While the first half of the Grand Line possesses highly volatile and unpredictable weather conditions, the "New World" is even more chaotic. Certain islands are relatively simple in terms of weather and climate, but other portions of the ocean defy the very laws of physics and nature themselves. Islands in the New World experience changes in their magnetic waves, which makes a special New World Log Pose (special compass) necessary so as not to get lost.*

![M](https://files.catbox.moe/cuq4h5.jpeg)

*Finally, the New World contains the island of Laugh Tale, the final island in the Grand Line. It is rumored that the legendary treasure of the Pirate King Gol D. Roger, One Piece, and the true history of the world, found on the Rio Poneglyph, are located on this island. But no one knows where Laugh Tale is because of World Government stopping anyone from finding out and one has to find all four coordinates which are on four different Road Ponegolyphs scattered throughout the New World.*

*In the New World, one doesn’t know what they’ll face. Especially if one moment it’s sunny and then the next, a massive hurricane forms out of nowhere. Anything could happen.*

*Perfume Yuda is the only ship of the "Kuja Pirates". It’s a giant red ship resembling a type of sailing ship characterized by a central rudder, an overhanging flat transom, watertight bulkheads, built using iron nails and clamps, and a flat-bottomed design. The large ocean-going vessel can also serves as a river ship, cargo ship, pleasure boat, and houseboat all in one while being able to house a whole army if needed. The ship has paddle wheels at the rear, a cabin with the architecture resembling those from ancient China, the front sail with the crew's Jolly Roger and the back sail with the kanji for "Kuja".*


![M](https://files.catbox.moe/ovcfk6.jpeg)
